BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to water recreation facilities; and amending RCW70.90.140.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.90.140 and 1986 c 236 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary shall enforce the rules adopted under thischapter. The secretary may develop joint plans of responsibility withany local health jurisdiction to administer this chapter. (2) Upon dissolution of a joint plan under subsection (1) of thissection, the department shall assume responsibility from the localhealth jurisdiction for enforcing the rules adopted under this chapter.In such cases, the department may not require changes in theinstallation of equipment at a facility if: (a) The equipment was installed at the time a joint plan was ineffect; (b) The equipment was installed in compliance with manufacturerspecifications; (c) The local health jurisdiction did not find the installation of p. 1 HB 1875the equipment out of compliance with rules adopted under this chapter;and (d) The manufacturer has not issued a recall or changed itsspecifications for placement of the equipment.
